name: Csesznek (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Csesznek: a red shield with a white castle with two towers and a hammer on a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
